members.name: OnBeforeDraw
members.signature: public override bool OnBeforeDraw(Paper paper, string id, Attribute attr, FieldInfo field, object target, int depth)

docs.summary: Called before the field is drawn. Return false to skip the field entirely.

members.name: OnAfterDraw
members.signature: public override void OnAfterDraw(Paper paper, string id, Attribute attr, FieldInfo field, object target, int depth)

docs.summary: Called after the field is drawn. Pairs with every [`OnBeforeDraw`](#api~Prowl.Editor.GUI.ReadOnlyAttributeHandler~OnBeforeDraw) that returned true, even when a later handler skips the field, so a scope opened there can always be closed.
